method.primary_metric: Generated tokens per second from eval_count/eval_duration; excludes prefill and loading.
method.selection: Highest median decoding throughput on tuning prompts; held-out confirmation reports separate paired results.
method.cpu_verification: Every request sets num_gpu=0; every response must have matching model digest and size_vram=0 in /api/ps.
method.cache: Model is warm before measurements. Prompt caching and filesystem cache are not controlled; available cached-token counts are recorded.
method.timing: First content-token latency uses streamed response arrival, not the server prompt timer.
method.limits: No hardware-level GPU trace, energy measurement, semantic quality evaluation, or control of other system load. Short outputs and prompts only.
